header.title: Unlocking new audience markets with automatic localization for live sports
header.subtitle: Provide realtime subtitling and translation from incoming live video source, while improving word accuracy with generative AI.

overview.description: Broadcasters and Streaming providers can enhance content delivery with automatic translation and subtitling workflows

subpoints.paragraph: Broadcasters and streaming providers can deliver subtitles in real time to expand their global reach.
AWS serverless compute, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon CloudFront enable service providers to effortlessly scale their services and flexibly support multiple languages for translation.
Generative AI delivers culturally resonant and nuanced translations tailored to each language, providing truly localized experiences.
